name: theme
title: Quartz theme
description: Support file: tokens, scoped base styles and the Tailwind v4 theme mapping.
author: design.how
docs:
Quartz is scoped: its styles apply only inside an element with the class quartz.
1. Import the theme once, in the root layout, as its own stylesheet (not an @import in globals.css): import '@/components/quartz/styles.css'
2. Put className="quartz" on the element that holds Quartz UI, usually <body>. Quartz's classes work on the elements inside it, in your own code too, not on that element itself.
3. Wrap the app inside that element in <QuartzPortalProvider> from '@/lib/quartz/portal', so dialogs and menus keep the theme.
Dark mode: put data-theme="dark" or the class dark on the quartz element or any ancestor, such as <html>. The theme does not follow the system setting (prefers-color-scheme) on its own.
Components: npx shadcn@latest add https://happyhands.cc/r/quartz/<name>.json; https://happyhands.cc/r/quartz/registry.json lists them all.

files.content:
/* Quartz tokens. The one file to retune.

   Palette: Frost. Cold navy ink on icy paper, cards on a cool fog canvas, and five cold kind tints. A kind shows as a word, never a fill.

   Rules
   - Hue names a kind of thing. Ink carries all text. Hue never colors text.
   - Five kind slots, in this order: agent cyan (h195), key orchid (h320), run blue (h250), deploy violet (h290)
     and model mint (h160). Two reserved status hues: warn amber (h68) and fail red (h26).
   - Warm means warn or fail. Every warm hue on screen (red, orange, amber, yellow, h0 to h90) is trouble.
     No kind, chart series, decoration or brand accent may take a warm hue, and the chassis has none.
   - Components never name a hue. They read --accent-mark, --accent-field, --accent-wash and
     --accent-line, which [data-kind] or [data-status] set on the nearest element.
   - Every hue has six steps. mark: bar fills, chart fills, legend squares. field: the flat full-bleed
     or inset field behind a section or product UI. wash: selection and focus in the app. line: a darker
     step for chart lines, outlines and other 1-2px marks that must meet 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). tint and label:
     the kind label, a soft ground and the dark word set on it.
   - Text on a hue uses --accent-on-field on a field and --text-on-field on a mark, fixed dark in both
     themes. Text on a wash is ink, because the wash flips with the theme. The kind label is the one
     tinted text: --accent-label on --accent-tint.
   - Floors, worked out on Quartz's color page (design.how/systems/quartz/foundations/color): ink on every field and wash is at
     least 7.5:1, ink on every mark at least 5:1, every line step at least 3:1 on paper and on the grey
     card, and every label at least 4.5:1 on its tint, in both themes. The dark theme points each line at
     its mark. Fills are flat: no ring, no shadow.
   - Everything is OKLCH and inside sRGB. Each component has one quiet grey frame line (--line-frame) with row rules inside it. The grey
     field is a well for code and output, never a container. Nothing casts a shadow except overlays.

   Format
   - One declaration per line: --name: value; followed by a comment of the form job | used by.
   - A line that starts with == opens a token group. Tools that list Quartz's tokens read both, so keep
     them when you retune.

   Scope: the tokens live on .quartz, not :root, so an app's own --space-* and --font-* on :root stay
   as they are. Derived tokens are declared again on [data-surface] so an inverse section
   recomputes them from its own ink and paper channels. */

/* Fonts. Quartz is drawn in Quartz Sans (Normal width) and Quartz Mono, which are declared
   on Quartz's own pages only and are not part of this theme. This file declares no @font-face, so each family
   stack (--font-sans, --font-mono) renders its fallback: the platform's UI sans and monospace.
   With a licence of your own, declare @font-face rules named "Quartz Sans"
   and "Quartz Mono", and they take over. */

.quartz {
  /* == Ink and paper == */
  --ink-c: 20% 0.024 262; /* the ink channel: cold navy graphite, 18.0:1 on --surface-page and 15.9:1 on --surface-card; every text and line is this at an alpha | all ink tokens */
  --paper-c: 99.7% 0.001 250; /* the paper channel: an icy white | all paper tokens */
  --grey-c: 95.6% 0.004 255; /* the grey field channel, cool like the ink | surface-card */
  --canvas-c: 99.1% 0.002 250; /* the canvas channel: the cool fog behind cards and frames | surface-canvas */
  --text-on-field-c: 20% 0.024 262; /* the fixed dark channel: text on hue and every shadow; never flips | text-on-field, elev-overlay */
  --shadow-alpha: 0.20; /* overlay shadow strength; the dark theme raises it | elev-overlay */

  /* == Category hues == */
  --hue-1-mark: oklch(86% 0.120 195); /* agent cyan mark, 12.4:1 with --text-on-field | bar fill, chart fill, legend square */
  --hue-1-field: oklch(92% 0.090 195); /* agent cyan field, 14.8:1 with --text-on-field | full-bleed section, product-line area */
  --hue-1-wash: oklch(96.5% 0.040 195); /* agent cyan wash, 16.6:1 with --text-1 | selected row, focused panel */
  --hue-1-line: oklch(60% 0.100 195); /* agent cyan line, 3.7:1 on --surface-page, 3.3:1 on --surface-card | chart line, outline */
  --hue-1-tint: oklch(89% 0.050 195); /* agent cyan label ground, 13.3:1 with --text-on-field | kind label */
  --hue-1-label: oklch(38% 0.062 195); /* agent cyan label word, 7.1:1 on --hue-1-tint | kind label */
  --hue-2-mark: oklch(82% 0.080 320); /* key orchid mark, 10.1:1 with --text-on-field | bar fill, chart fill, legend square */
  --hue-2-field: oklch(90% 0.060 320); /* key orchid field, 13.2:1 with --text-on-field | full-bleed section, product-line area */
  --hue-2-wash: oklch(96% 0.030 320); /* key orchid wash, 16.0:1 with --text-1 | selected row, focused panel */
  --hue-2-line: oklch(58% 0.075 320); /* key orchid line, 4.4:1 on --surface-page, 3.9:1 on --surface-card | chart line, outline */
  --hue-2-tint: oklch(89% 0.050 320); /* key orchid label ground, 12.8:1 with --text-on-field | kind label */
  --hue-2-label: oklch(38% 0.062 320); /* key orchid label word, 7.3:1 on --hue-2-tint | kind label */
  --hue-3-mark: oklch(72% 0.100 250); /* run blue mark, 7.3:1 with --text-on-field | bar fill, chart fill, legend square */
  --hue-3-field: oklch(82% 0.060 250); /* run blue field, 10.4:1 with --text-on-field | full-bleed section, product-line area */
  --hue-3-wash: oklch(94.5% 0.020 250); /* run blue wash, 15.4:1 with --text-1 | selected row, focused panel */
  --hue-3-line: oklch(52% 0.150 250); /* run blue line, 5.5:1 on --surface-page, 4.8:1 on --surface-card | chart line, outline */
  --hue-3-tint: oklch(89% 0.050 250); /* run blue label ground, 13.1:1 with --text-on-field | kind label */
  --hue-3-label: oklch(38% 0.062 250); /* run blue label word, 7.2:1 on --hue-3-tint | kind label */
  --hue-4-mark: oklch(72% 0.110 290); /* deploy violet mark, 7.1:1 with --text-on-field | bar fill, chart fill, legend square */
  --hue-4-field: oklch(83% 0.065 290); /* deploy violet field, 10.6:1 with --text-on-field | full-bleed section, product-line area */
  --hue-4-wash: oklch(95% 0.025 290); /* deploy violet wash, 15.6:1 with --text-1 | selected row, focused panel */
  --hue-4-line: oklch(54% 0.150 290); /* deploy violet line, 5.3:1 on --surface-page, 4.7:1 on --surface-card | chart line, outline */
  --hue-4-tint: oklch(89% 0.050 290); /* deploy violet label ground, 12.9:1 with --text-on-field | kind label */
  --hue-4-label: oklch(38% 0.062 290); /* deploy violet label word, 7.3:1 on --hue-4-tint | kind label */
  --hue-5-mark: oklch(75% 0.100 160); /* model mark, 8.5:1 with --text-on-field | bar fill, chart fill, legend square */
  --hue-5-field: oklch(90% 0.070 160); /* model field, 13.8:1 with --text-on-field | full-bleed section, product-line area */
  --hue-5-wash: oklch(96% 0.035 160); /* model wash, 16.3:1 with --text-1 | selected row, focused panel */
  --hue-5-line: oklch(52% 0.090 160); /* model line, 5.2:1 on --surface-page, 4.6:1 on --surface-card | chart line, outline */
  --hue-5-tint: oklch(89% 0.050 160); /* model label ground, 13.3:1 with --text-on-field | kind label */
  --hue-5-label: oklch(38% 0.062 160); /* model label word, 7.1:1 on --hue-5-tint | kind label */

  /* == Reserved status hues == */
  --warn-mark: oklch(80% 0.152 68); /* amber: degraded, slow, retrying; 9.4:1 with --text-on-field; warm, so never a kind | warn chip */
  --warn-field: oklch(89% 0.056 68); /* warn field, 12.9:1 with --text-on-field | warn banner, warn toast */
  --warn-wash: oklch(96% 0.028 68); /* warn wash, 16.1:1 with --text-1 | warn row */
  --warn-line: oklch(62% 0.132 68); /* warn line, 3.7:1 on --surface-page, 3.3:1 on --surface-card | warn series, warn outline */
  --fail-mark: oklch(65.2% 0.219 26); /* red: errored, crashed, 5xx; 5.1:1 with --text-on-field; warm, so never a kind | destructive button */
  --fail-field: oklch(82% 0.055 26); /* fail field, 10.2:1 with --text-on-field | fail banner, fail toast */
  --fail-wash: oklch(94.5% 0.027 26); /* fail wash, 15.3:1 with --text-1 | fail row, invalid field */
  --fail-line: oklch(60% 0.236 26); /* fail line, 4.4:1 on --surface-page, 3.9:1 on --surface-card | fail series, fail outline */
  --warn-text: oklch(49% 0.100 68); /* warn word, 6.4:1 on --surface-page, 5.6:1 on --surface-card | status word, warn text */
  --fail-text: oklch(51% 0.180 26); /* fail word, 6.3:1 on --surface-page, 5.6:1 on --surface-card | status word, error text */

  /* == Type families == */
  --font-sans: "Quartz Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; /* all UI and prose: Quartz Sans where declared, else the platform UI sans | every text role */
  --font-mono: "Quartz Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; /* Quartz Mono where declared, else the platform monospace | ordinals, codes, IDs, code blocks */

  /* == Type weights == */
  --weight-body: 340; /* Regular | running text */
  --weight-medium: 400; /* Medium | labels, buttons, headings, display */
  --weight-strong: 500; /* Semibold | emphasis inside prose, code keywords */
  --width-normal: normal; /* each face's own width; Quartz Sans's Normal file has no width axis, and a "wdth" value here would stretch the fallback sans | every role */
  --features-data: "tnum", "zero", "ss04"; /* tabular figures, slashed zero, serif I; every duration, count and value | tables, labels, stats, data roles */
  --features-id: "ss04"; /* serif I tells I, l and 1 apart | identifiers in sans */

  /* == Type roles == */
  --type-display-xl: 400 80px/80px var(--font-sans); /* marketing hero, line-height 1.0 | hero */
  --type-display-lg: 400 60px/66px var(--font-sans); /* section heads, line-height 1.1 | marketing sections */
  --type-display: 400 40px/44px var(--font-sans); /* mobile hero, page titles with stats | app page title, docs H1 */
  --type-heading-lg: 400 32px/36px var(--font-sans); /* page titles | docs H1 on mobile, settings title */
  --type-heading: 400 24px/28px var(--font-sans); /* panel and section titles | docs H2, dialog title */
  --type-heading-sm: 400 20px/24px var(--font-sans); /* subsection titles | docs H3, card title */
  --type-heading-xs: 400 16px/20px var(--font-sans); /* in-thread headings | response ## */
  --type-body-lg: 340 16px/22px var(--font-sans); /* marketing and docs prose, line-height 1.4 | docs lede */
  --type-body: 340 14px/20px var(--font-sans); /* app prose | descriptions, table text */
  --type-body-sm: 380 13px/18px var(--font-sans); /* dense meta, a step heavier than body so meta on text-3 still reads | captions, helper text */
  --type-button: 400 16px/20px var(--font-sans); /* default and large button label | button */
  --type-label: 400 14px/16px var(--font-sans); /* controls and table cells | input, menu item, tab */
  --type-label-sm: 400 12px/16px var(--font-sans); /* small tags, column heads | badge, table head */
  --type-code: 400 13px/20px var(--font-mono); /* code blocks | code block, log line */
  --type-code-sm: 400 12px/16px var(--font-mono); /* IDs, ordinals, paths in tables | inline code, kbd */
  --type-tag: var(--type-code-sm); /* ids, methods, status codes and paths in a row or a code tag; the metrics of code-sm under its own name so the two cannot drift | row id, code tag, key tail */
  --type-code-display: 400 32px/36px var(--font-mono); /* a code a person reads aloud or types on another device | CLI device code, recovery code */
  --type-code-touch: 400 16px/22px var(--font-mono); /* code typed into a field on touch; 16px so iOS WebKit does not zoom on focus (trap/touch-input-zoom) | terminal input, code inputs below 640px */
  --type-stat-xl: 400 48px/52px var(--font-sans); /* marketing stat numerals, tabular figures, plain sans | stat size xl */
  --type-stat-lg: 400 40px/44px var(--font-sans); /* hero stat in the app, tabular figures | stat size lg */
  --type-stat: 400 32px/36px var(--font-sans); /* app stat numerals, tabular figures | stat, metric */
  --type-state-word: 400 14px/16px var(--font-sans); /* status words, the label role in sentence case | status word */
  --tracking-display: -0.025em; /* display sizes | display-xl, display-lg, display */
  --tracking-heading: -0.015em; /* heading sizes | heading-lg, heading, heading-sm */
  --tracking-body: -0.01em; /* 16px text: body-lg and button | body-lg, button */
  --tracking-text: 0em; /* 14px and below, where negative tracking closes the counters | body, body-sm, label, label-sm */

  /* == Space == */
  --space-0-5: 2px; /* optical nudge | tag inner gap */
  --space-1: 4px; /* icon to label inside tags | tag, badge */
  --space-2: 8px; /* control inner gap, button arrow gap | button, input */
  --space-3: 12px; /* control padding, table cell padding | input, table */
  --space-4: 16px; /* card padding, mobile gutter, button padding | card, button */
  --space-5: 20px; /* grid gap in the app | grid */
  --space-6: 24px; /* section padding in the app, desktop gutter | panel, docs */
  --space-8: 32px; /* between app sections | docs sections */
  --space-10: 40px; /* marketing block gap | marketing */
  --space-15: 60px; /* marketing sub-section gap | marketing */
  --space-20: 80px; /* marketing section gap | marketing */
  --space-30: 120px; /* hero top padding | hero */

  /* == Layout == */
  --container: 1120px; /* marketing and docs content width | page container */
  --sidebar: 248px; /* app and docs sidebar width | sidebar */
  --toc: 200px; /* docs on-this-page column | docs layout */
  --topbar: 56px; /* app and docs top bar height | top bar */
  --gutter: 24px; /* page gutter at desktop | page */
  --gutter-sm: 16px; /* page gutter on phones | page */
  --control-xs: 24px; /* the action in a 40px header, 8px from its edges | button xs, chip xs, segmented xs, filter bar xs */
  --control-sm: 28px; /* small control height, the sm of every control | button sm, chip, segmented sm, field sm, tag input */
  --control: 32px; /* default control height, wider than tall: 16px of padding a side | button, input, select, slider thumb */
  --tag: 20px; /* a tag's height: the smallest box that holds a 12px label, a count or a key cap | badge, code tag, kbd, ink slot sm, sidebar count */
  --control-lg: 44px; /* large control and touch target | button lg */
  --overlay-sm: 400px; /* small dialog and confirm width | dialog sm, alert dialog */
  --overlay: 480px; /* default dialog, sheet and drawer content width | dialog, sheet, drawer */
  --overlay-lg: 640px; /* wide dialog for forms and previews | dialog lg */
  --popover: 288px; /* popover and picker panel width | popover, mode picker */
  --toast-width: 384px; /* toast stack width from 640px up; full width below | toaster */
  --popover-sm: 256px; /* a short info panel opened from an info button | popover info */
  --tooltip-max: 256px; /* tooltip line length before it wraps | tooltip, chart tooltip */
  --hint-width: 420px; /* widest a full-text hint grows; still capped at the viewport less the phone gutters | truncate hint */
  --menu-min: 192px; /* narrowest a menu opens, so short labels still give a usable target row | dropdown menu, filter bar menu, attachment row */
  --popup-max: 320px; /* tallest a list popup grows before it scrolls | select, combobox, command list, prompt-input menu, chart data table */
  --menu-width: 320px; /* width the @ and / list opens at beside the caret; narrower on a phone | prompt-input menu */
  --field-max-height: calc(var(--control-lg) * 4); /* tallest a wrapping chips field grows, four touch rows, before it scrolls | combobox chips */
  --row-sm: 32px; /* compact row, for dense data | table size sm */
  --row: 40px; /* default row, one line | table, item */
  --row-lg: 56px; /* a row with a second line | table size lg, item with a description */
  --label-column: 160px; /* widest a description-list label column grows before it wraps | data list */
  --measure: 68ch; /* long-form reading measure | prose */
  --tab-max: 220px; /* widest a document tab grows before its title truncates | tabs document variant */
  --sidebar-icon: calc(var(--control) + var(--space-4)); /* collapsed sidebar width: one control plus 8px a side | sidebar icon mode */
  --attachment-media: 40px; /* the media square in an attachment row; size sm uses 32px, --row-sm | attachment */
  --attachment-max: 256px; /* widest an attachment chip in the composer grows before its name truncates | prompt-input attachment */
  --grab-size: 40px; /* length of a sheet's grab bar | sheet */
  --fade-edge: 24px; /* the mask fade at the clipped edge of a sideways scroller | suggestions scroll */
  --fade-line-end: 16px; /* the mask fade at the end of one line of text that overflows, in place of an ellipsis | segmented control label */
  --measure-hint: 60ch; /* a description under a title, a page lede or a field's hint, shorter than prose | field description, section description, page header description */
  --measure-short: 48ch; /* an empty state's title and line, set top-left in the body | empty state */
  --page-header-max: 720px; /* widest a page header's title block grows beside its actions | page header */
  --search-min: 200px; /* narrowest the filter bar's search gets before the filters wrap under it | filter bar */
  --search-max: 320px; /* widest the filter bar's search grows once the bar has room | filter bar */
  --crumb-floor: 8ch; /* shortest the page crumb truncates to before the trail folds another crumb | breadcrumb trail */
  --log-level: 5ch; /* the level column, as wide as the longest level word | log viewer */
  --status-column: 128px; /* a right-aligned status column, wide enough for the status "Waiting on you" | table, tool call, timeline */
  --timeline-name: 200px; /* the widest the name column of a timeline gets from 576px; narrower frames give it 40%, and never less than --timeline-name-min | timeline */
  --timeline-name-min: 120px; /* the least the name column of a timeline keeps, so a label never shrinks to a stub | timeline */
  --timeline-label-min: 10ch; /* the least a span name keeps before its figure is hidden, so a name never shrinks to a stub | timeline */
  --time-column: 12ch; /* a column of relative times, wide enough for the first paint's date ("Sep 30, 2025") so the swap to "3m ago" never moves it | relative time column */
  --stat-placeholder: 4ch; /* the loading bar standing in for a stat's value, about four digits | stat */
  --tool-detail-min: 6ch; /* the least of a tool call's detail kept before its status wraps to a second line | tool call */
  --line-box: 1lh; /* one line of the text it sits in; lh resolves where it is read | prose rhythm, stat, status, toast mark, date picker field, prompt input, tool call output */
  --skeleton-text: 0.7em; /* a text skeleton bar, about the cap height of the text it stands for | skeleton text */
  --code-inline: 0.9em; /* inline code, a step under the text around it so mono does not look larger | code */

  /* == Radius == */
  --radius-0: 0px; /* a straight edge: the shared edges of cells in a strip, bitmap pixels | frame-shared inner edges, switch thumb */
  --radius-inner: 4px; /* a box inside a control or a row: the selected segment, badges, chips, row fills, a menu item | segment thumb, badge, chip, menu item */
  --radius-soft: 6px; /* a control: buttons, fields, the segmented track, code tags | button, input, select, segmented control */
  --radius-frame: 10px; /* a component's outer edge and every overlay | card, table, dialog, popover, menu, toast */
  --radius-full: 999px; /* round means a person: avatars and the presence mark, plus the radio so it never reads as a checkbox | avatar, presence, radio */

  /* == Lines == */
  --line-hair: 1px; /* dividers, rings | separator, ring */
  --line-accent: 2px; /* the 2px accent stroke | active tab underline, progress connector, table resize handle, chart line */
  --line-focus: 2px; /* focus outline width | every focusable */
  --focus-offset: 2px; /* focus outline offset | every focusable */
  --line-frame-alpha: 0.14; /* the ink alpha of a frame's edge: a quiet grey line, so a screen of frames reads light | line-frame */
  --mark-size: 8px; /* the legend square and the menu radio dot | chart legend, radio item */
  --ring-cutout: 2px; /* the gap ring that cuts an overlapping avatar out of the surface | avatar group */
  --chart-dash: 6 4; /* stroke-dasharray for a comparison or projected series | chart */
  --chart-axis-gap: 8px; /* gap between a tick label and the plot; chart.tsx reads it into its layout | chart */

  /* == Motion == */
  --dur-press: 60ms; /* press feedback | button */
  --dur-fast: 120ms; /* hover: color, wash and edge changes on every interactive element, and a menu, popover or tooltip leaving, on --ease-step | button, row, link, chip, menu */
  --dur-base: 160ms; /* menus, popovers, selects, tooltips and toasts in, opacity only; they leave on the shorter --dur-fast | menu, popover, toast */
  --dur-slow: 180ms; /* dialogs and sheets: opacity, plus --sheet-shift for a sheet | dialog, sheet */
  --dur-spin: 800ms; /* one turn of a pending ring (--ease-spin) | spinner, button, input, progress ring, send button */
  --dur-run: 1000ms; /* one turn of the running status arc (animate-run) | status arc */
  --dur-slide: 1200ms; /* one pass of the indeterminate progress segment (animate-slide) | progress bar */
  --ease-spin: linear; /* the pending ring turns smoothly | animate-spin */
  --thumb-lift: 0%; /* how much ink the selected segment takes beyond paper; the dark theme raises it | surface-thumb */
  --thumb-ring-alpha: 0; /* the ink alpha of the selected segment's 1px ring; the dark theme raises it | elev-thumb */
  --skeleton-step: 0%; /* how much ink the skeleton fill takes beyond the grey field; the dark theme raises it | skeleton */
  --dur-skeleton-delay: 150ms; /* wait before a skeleton shows, so fast loads never flash one | skeleton swap */
  --dur-skeleton-hold: 400ms; /* shortest time a shown skeleton stays, so it never blinks | skeleton swap */
  --toast-read-base: 3000ms; /* reading time every toast gets | toast */
  --toast-read-char: 60ms; /* reading time per character of title and description | toast */
  --toast-read-action: 3000ms; /* extra time when the toast carries an action | toast */
  --toast-read-min: 4000ms; /* shortest a toast stays | toast */
  --toast-read-max: 12000ms; /* longest a toast stays before it waits for the person | toast */
  --scale-press: 0.98; /* the scale a pressed button or chip settles at | button, chip */
  --ease-step: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); /* the standard curve for every state change: hover, press, chip toggle, row select, tab switch | every interactive element */
  --sheet-shift: 8px; /* how far a sheet travels from its edge as it appears | sheet */

  /* == Layers == */
  --z-raised: 10; /* a part lifted over its siblings inside one component | sticky table, data grid and dialog header and footer, focused tab, segment or grouped button, resize handles, item actions, avatar badge, select scroll arrows, code editor gutter, message time, conversation scroll button, attachment link */
  --z-above: 20; /* a part that sits over a raised part | dialog close over its sticky header, resizable value label, attachment actions over its link, condensed page header */
  --z-cover: 30; /* a layer over every part of its component | nested dialog dim, focused attachment link */
  --z-drop: 40; /* a layer over a whole component while a file is dragged over it, or a bar floating over the page; under every overlay | attachment drop zone, bulk action bar */
  --z-overlay: 50; /* every portalled layer; one layer, so the one opened last sits on top by DOM order | dialog, sheet, popover, menu, select, combobox, tooltip, toast, chart tooltip, mobile sidebar, skip link */

  /* == Code == */
  --code-string-alpha: 0.80; /* the alpha of ink in a string; the dark theme lowers it so strings part from plain code | code */
  --code-comment-alpha: 0.66; /* the alpha of ink in a comment; --code-comment is 5.3:1 on --surface-card in both themes | code */
}

/* Derived tokens. Declared on every element that changes a channel, so they recompute there. */
.quartz, .quartz [data-surface] {
  /* == Surface == */
  --ink: oklch(var(--ink-c)); /* solid ink | primary text, primary button */
  --paper: oklch(var(--paper-c)); /* solid paper | page background */
